cases.purpose: Select all eligible outside-session PIDs while excluding the real caller, its session, kernel and malformed records.
cases.oracle: A per-observation synthetic proc tree is checked against known records, and the candidate shell PID and SID are independently cross-checked with getsid and the live caller stat. The expected set is derived from the fixture roles and omit arguments, never from candidate output. Setup executes PID parser positive/negative controls and a native seccomp signal-syscall guard control. The guard prevents delivery and makes an attempted signal syscall fatal.
cases.comparison: Compare the complete unordered unique PID set, raw exit status and stderr with the independent expected set and status. Unreadable-root errors require a nonempty opendir diagnostic. Setup or per-observation precondition failure and missing/truncated diagnostics require primary adjudication as incomplete, not a candidate behavior failure.
cases.candidate_script:
exec ./guard "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'ulimit -f 128 || exit 89
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/killall5-dry-run-reviewed.py prepare baseline "$$" >"$HOME/prepare.out" 2>"$HOME/prepare.err" || { printf '"'"'fixture-precondition-failed\n'"'"' >&2; exit 90; }
export BASHOS_PROC_ROOT=/tmp/parity-case/proc-fixture
rc=0
killall5 --dry-run >"$HOME/candidate.out" 2>"$HOME/candidate.err" || rc=$?
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$rc" >"$HOME/candidate.status"
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/killall5-dry-run-reviewed.py verify baseline
'
